content.short: Eden Network is a suite of MEV tools unlocking maximum value for Ethereum validators, MEV searchers, and end users.
content.description: Founded in 2020 by Caleb Sheridan, Eden Network is a protocol that minimizes the negative externalities of MEV to unlock maximum value for Ethereum validators, MEV searchers, and end users. It comprises three interrelated products—Eden RPC, Eden Relay, and Eden Bundles—each designed for a specific audience: Ethereum users, Ethereum validators and block builders, and Ethereum MEV searchers, respectively. The three components are intended to function together to serve the Ethereum ecosystem.
content.meta: Eden Network reduces MEV externalities to unlock value for Ethereum validators and users. Discover Eden Network and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
